record.paper_title: Open Problems on Configuration Spaces of Tensegrities
record.original_question: In planar Cayley algebra, whose objects are points and lines in the plane and whose basic operations are join (forming the line through two points) and meet (forming the intersection point of two lines), determine when two Cayley algebra systems define the same tensegrity stratum.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Work in the real projective plane. The planar Cayley algebra is the algebraic system whose objects are points and lines and whose basic operations are:
- join: given two distinct points P, Q, the line P ∨ Q passing through them;
- meet: given two distinct lines ℓ, m, their intersection point ℓ ∧ m.

A Cayley algebra system (in finitely many input points) is a finite sequence of such join/meet operations starting from a tuple of input points, producing as outputs certain derived points and lines whose construction may be conditioned on incidence equations among the constructed objects.

A tensegrity framework on a graph G with n vertices is a realization of the n vertices as points p_1, …, p_n in the plane (the edges are drawn as straight segments). The framework admits a non-trivial self-stress (equivalently, lies in the tensegrity stratum of G) if and only if the points (p_1, …, p_n) satisfy certain algebraic conditions on the configuration space (ℝℙ^2)^n. The (closure of the) locus of all such configurations is the tensegrity stratum associated to G.

A Cayley algebra system S is said to define a tensegrity stratum Σ if the set of input configurations for which S can be performed (all required meets/joins exist and all imposed incidence conditions hold) is exactly Σ.

Problem. Give necessary and sufficient conditions under which two planar Cayley algebra systems S_1 and S_2 (possibly using different intermediate constructions and incidence relations) define the same tensegrity stratum. Equivalently, classify planar Cayley algebra systems up to defining the same tensegrity stratum.

artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in the list of open problems on configuration spaces of tensegrities by Karpenkov (Arnold Mathematical Journal, 2018). Related work (Karpenkov 2017; Karpenkov–Müller 2021) constructs Cayley/Grassmann–Cayley algebra systems describing tensegrity strata in the plane and in higher dimensions, but the classification of equivalent Cayley algebra systems (when two systems define the same stratum) does not appear to have been resolved in subsequent literature. Status: open.
